currentSprintFocus: 2026-08-24 through 2026-08-26: continuation of the same unplanned sprint. Demandes (M5) redesigned last among the registry modules (audit → plan → implement, same process as M3/M4/M6/M7): concept-first registry replacing the generic DataTable, GET /demandes/aggregates, server-side search (resolves demandeur/traducteur/document names to candidate IDs), requests.permissions.ts centralizing an action matrix that had drifted across route/service/UI. Follow-up discussion surfaced that the agent role had no tailored space at all — built a real agent-only landing (/mon-espace + /mes-missions, role-gated via new AgentRoute/NonAgentRoute, which also closed a pre-existing gap where /dashboard was nav-hidden from agents but reachable by direct URL), a /profil page (identity + self-service password change), and a reusable QuickUploadDialog now shared between Demandes' document picker and mission-report uploads. Backend additions: getDemandesAggregates/getMissionsAggregates both gained optional per-user scoping (demandeurId/participantId), MissionsAggregates gained rapportsEnAttente, POST /auth/changer-mot-de-passe (self-service, distinct from first-login set-password), users.poste/service/direction (migration 0014, populated only via the Personnel ANAC picker), and password-complexity validation (validerForceMotDePasse) now actually enforced server-side in all three password-setting paths including bootstrap, which previously had none at all. Found and fixed one real bug live: /auth/me's dernière connexion only matched the CONNEXION audit action, missing accounts that had only ever completed first-login (OTP_VALIDE → MOT_DE_PASSE_DEFINI) — caught by the user testing their own account. See changelog.md's 2026-08-26 entry for full detail.

activeSession.task: Continuation of the agent-role-hardening + translation-export work: user tested it live and reported 4 issues — priority couldn't be re-validated once set (fixed: canValidatePriority no longer gates on !prioriteValidee), the PDF/DOCX download buttons were invisible to admin (fixed: they'd only been wired into the agent-only TraductionPreview, never into TraductionEditeur/WorkshopHeader — added there too), the translated-text preview could overflow the screen on long documents (fixed: max-h-[45vh] scrollable boxes + an 85vh dialog cap), and the PDF put source/translated text side-by-side (fixed: stacked full-width sections with a page break). Also asked to make DOCX match the PDF's formatting — rewrote genererDOCXTraduction using docx's Table/TableRow/ImageRun primitives to replicate the masthead+seal+info-table+page-break layout, live-generated and sent both files to the user for visual review. Separately, discussed whether Documents should support downloads for all users — surfaced a much bigger pre-existing bug in the process: there was no working download button anywhere in Documents, for any role (getUrlTelechargement existed, dead code, never called). User proposed a separate /archives section; walked through why that's unnecessary — added a 'Télécharger' action visible to everyone, plus a finalesUniquement filter (version-chain-leaf inference: excludes documents another row supersedes via parentId, correctly includes both the latest version of a chain and documents that were never versioned). An explicit boolean/categorie flag was briefly agreed as the approach then reasoned back out of once the inference approach was shown to already cover every case with no schema change. Live-validated against the dev DB with a synthetic 3-document version chain. Server tsc clean, client tsc+build+eslint clean throughout. Doc-sync done, about to do Notion + commit/push.
